_doc: The exit wardens (scripts/space/wardens.gd, docs/MECHANICS_REVIEW.md P7): every region's exit beacon is held by a warden, a strong generated ship (scripts/space/shipgen.gd) you can read about on the region's card before you choose the region. At the beacon you pay its toll, are waved through on good terms, or break through. The guarding faction of a region is its `faction` when that is one of the entries here, else its `enemies` faction (else the Rustfangs); the ending region has no exit and no warden. stage_size: the hull class of the warden at stage 1..8. stage_budget_mult: its budget over what a pirate of that place would get, by stage. jumps_ahead: the warden is built for the budget you will meet about this many jumps into the region (the exit), so a region's warden is known when you choose it. wardens: per guarding faction (an id of data/enemy_tables.json): name (the warden's name), hail (what it says at the beacon), hint (one line on its real loadout and what beats it, from that faction's menu in data/enemy_tables.json), toll (credits per stage; 0 or missing = no toll), pass_rep (the reputation with that faction at which it waves you through; missing = never), rep_on_fight (the reputation change for shooting your way through; 0 for hostile factions, who have no bar). A won, spared or captured warden, or one that escaped, leaves the lane; winning also pays 50 credits per stage.

clans.name: Clan Hulk
clans.hail: A scrapper clan has strung its hulks across the beacon, gun ports open. "Lane fee, friend. Family rates for anyone Ma speaks well of."
clans.hint: Layers of scrap and heavy plate over a big crew with poor aim. Bring lasers or beams: plate shrugs off bolts.

concord.name: Concord Bulwark
concord.hail: A Concord picket sits across the beacon behind a wall of shield. "Halt for inspection. The lane fee is on file."
concord.hint: A shield wall that answers with lasers and the odd missile. Bring ion, missiles or a beam.

lumen.name: Lumen Lattice
lumen.hail: A web of neon unfolds round the beacon, bright enough to hurt. "The lane is kept. Be kept, or be cleared."
lumen.hint: Mirrored plate turns lasers aside, with neon shields and ion on top. Bring kinetic guns or missiles.

rustfangs.name: Rustfang Ripper
rustfangs.hail: Scrap-plated hulls spread across the lane, ram bows forward. "Toll! Pay up, or we scrape you off the beacon."
rustfangs.hint: Scrap-plated and often ram-bowed. Bring dampeners, range or speed, and don't let it reach you.

hollow.name: Hollow Absence
hollow.hail: Nothing hails you. The beacon is dark, and the hulls round it turn towards you in the same instant.
hollow.hint: Mirror veils, leech lasers and harpoons. What beats it you learn by meeting one: bring a little of everything.
